source claimDark, bare-glass, fresh-NC-film glass and the same film aged11 weeks are compared. NC-film photocurrent is about an order of magnitude above bare glass and approximately four orders above dark current. Aging lowers it nearly threefold but leaves it above reference. No precise absolute current or device efficiency is inferred from the curves. · Source claim class: reported. G6: LSC film loading, thickness, preparation/drying detail, exact loading variant and device efficiency are absent.
